commitment_note: Committed before any Phase 0b render metrics are inspected. Numeric tolerances are NOT set here; they are established only through the five-characterization/two-held-out protocol below. This file is immutable for the first capture attempt.

rgb_mask_leakage_mean_max.formula: max over three per-channel mean normalized intensities outside the forward mask dilated by rgb_mask_dilation_pixels; mask constructed NumPy-only from the same center with radius forward_mask_radius_pixels + rgb_mask_dilation_pixels (no SciPy morphology)
rgb_mask_leakage_mean_max.smallest_intended_detectable_regression: leakage beyond the committed dilation radius
rgb_mask_leakage_mean_max.boundary_mutation: leakage beyond the committed dilation radius

rgb_masked_rmse.formula: sqrt(mean(square(actual - baseline), dtype=float64)) over all pixels inside the original circular mask and all three channels, on selected decoded JPEG frames in float64 normalized to [0,1]
rgb_masked_rmse.smallest_intended_detectable_regression: localized block corruption covering more than 1% of evaluated samples; channel swap
rgb_masked_rmse.boundary_mutation: one-code global intensity shift (expected pass/fail follows margin policy)

rgb_masked_abs_error_p99.formula: np.percentile(abs(actual - baseline), 99, method='linear') over all pixels inside the original circular mask and all three channels, on selected decoded JPEG frames in float64 normalized to [0,1]

depth_non_max_mask_iou.formula: integer intersection count divided by integer union count of non-max pixels (using the shared encoded sentinel) within the circular mask; empty union or intersection fails

depth_error_p50.formula: np.percentile(abs(actual - baseline), 50, method='linear') on the non-empty intersection of actual/baseline non-max pixels within the circular mask, in absolute encoded units
depth_error_p50.smallest_intended_detectable_regression: wrong depth scale; constant encoded offset

depth_error_p95.formula: np.percentile(abs(actual - baseline), 95, method='linear') on the non-empty intersection of actual/baseline non-max pixels within the circular mask, in absolute encoded units

depth_error_p99.formula: np.percentile(abs(actual - baseline), 99, method='linear') on the non-empty intersection of actual/baseline non-max pixels within the circular mask, in absolute encoded units

selected_frames.selector: first/middle/last frame (integer floor for middle) from every pinned episode, de-duplicated within an episode while preserving order
selected_frames.note: For five pinned episodes this is fifteen RGB/depth pairs.

characterization_protocol.cache_policy: record filesystem/shader cache policy; include at least one documented cold-cache or machine-restart characterization when practical, otherwise record that limitation explicitly
characterization_protocol.retention_policy: failed-run stages and partial evidence are retained for a documented diagnostic period rather than automatically deleted

threshold_derivation.leakage_source: worst absolute observation across baseline + characterization runs
threshold_derivation.held_out_rule: neither held-out run contributes to threshold derivation; both must pass every derived threshold; a failure invalidates the capture attempt and requires a fresh complete protocol

characterization_protocol.report_only_all_frame_distributions: when full baseline/candidate renders are available, calculate report-only all-frame metric distributions in addition to the binding selected frames

must_fail_rgb: localized block corruption covering more than 1% of evaluated samples
mutation_suite.boundary_probe: a global one-code RGB shift is a documented boundary probe whose expected pass/fail result follows the committed margin policy; do not require it to fail if it is intentionally within tolerance

determinism_preconditions.minimum_channel_difference_before_channe: establish and assert a minimum channel-difference precondition before channel swapping
determinism_preconditions.one_frame_latency_probe: choose one-frame-latency probes with sufficient baseline frame-to-frame metric separation and use a precommitted larger offset fallback; if a realistic one-frame latency is below the pinned scene's tolerant metric threshold, record that limitation and rely on the exact mocked call-trace test for ordering rather than loosening the golden threshold
determinism_preconditions.pinned_corruption_sizes: pin exact corruption sizes/magnitudes for intensity shifts, depth offsets, mask erosion/expansion, and block corruption

mutation_suite.unexpected_pass_invalidates: every unexpected mutation pass invalidates threshold acceptance and triggers investigation

boundary_budget_fixtures: narrow JPEG-block-edge RGB mask leakage expected to pass
leakage beyond the committed dilation radius expected to fail
widespread one-code and localized high-intensity exterior leakage with predeclared outcomes
small depth-mask boundary perturbation expected to pass
meaningful depth-mask-area loss expected to fail
deterministic_mutation_preconditions: mutation fixtures must make rejection deterministic
establish and assert a minimum channel-difference precondition before channel swapping
choose one-frame-latency probes with sufficient baseline frame-to-frame metric separation and use a precommitted larger offset fallback
pin exact corruption sizes/magnitudes for intensity shifts, depth offsets, mask erosion/expansion, and block corruption

controlled_rebaselining.rule: never edit a baseline in place
controlled_rebaselining.trigger: a changed source commit or entry point alone does not trigger re-baselining; only an approved equality-required input/config/runtime change does
controlled_rebaselining.procedure: explicit provenance-update PR that retains the old baseline/metrics, explains every binding change, runs old and new environments where available, repeats the complete capture protocol, obtains independent approval, and assigns a new immutable baseline/provenance ID
